title: Check the parts, then drill the joint holes in both bed sides
text: Check every part against the cut list (tape label, length, width and thickness) before you drill anything.
Lay both sides inside face up: the right side M01, at the bed's open end, and the left side M02, which stands against the bookcase.

On each side, mark the four joint rows as dimensioned in the drawing: the top and bottom rows from the front edge, the two headboard rows up from each headboard's lower end, 3/8 in from the wall edge.
Drill the 3/8 in dowel holes 1/2 in deep, then the 3/16 in screw holes right through.
Turn each side over and countersink the screw holes on the outside face.
warnings: Set the depth stop and test every hole size on scrap first.

title: Fit the threaded inserts T and the mounting plates I to both sides
text: On each side's inside face, mark the eight insert holes from the front edge and up from the bottom end, as dimensioned in the drawing. Both sides use the same layout.
Five of the holes are placed by alignment on Rockler's drawing, not by a printed dimension: lay the plate on the marks and check every hole lines up before drilling.
Drill each hole 27/64 in, 9/16 in deep, square to the face.
Drive a threaded insert T into each hole until it sits flush with the face.
Fix the mounting plate I-R to M01 and I-L to M02, each with eight M8 x 16 mm screws U, snug.
warnings: Set the depth stop and test every hole size on scrap first.
Fix the mounting plates only with the inserts and the M8 screws: never use wood screws.

title: Join the upper headboard M05 to the top M03
text: Lay the top M03 inside face up (the face that points down into the cabinet), wall edge toward you.
Mark the headboard row 3/8 in from the wall edge, from the end at M01, as dimensioned in the drawing: three dowel holes and four screw holes.
Drill the 3/8 in dowel holes 1/2 in deep and the 3/16 in screw holes right through, then countersink the screw holes on the top's upper face.
Drill the upper headboard M05's top edge centred in the thickness (use the dowel jig): 3/8 in dowel holes 1 1/16 in deep and 1/8 in pilots 1 1/4 in deep.
Glue in the dowels and the panel edge, fit the panel, then drive the screws snug, not tight.
warnings: Keep M05's ends flush with M03's ends: both must fit between the sides.

title: Join the lower headboard M06 to the bottom M04
text: Lay the bottom M04 inside face up (the face that points up into the cabinet), wall edge toward you.
Mark the headboard row 3/8 in from the wall edge, from the end at M01, as dimensioned in the drawing: three dowel holes and four screw holes.
Drill the 3/8 in dowel holes 1/2 in deep and the 3/16 in screw holes right through, then countersink the screw holes on the bottom's underside.
Drill the lower headboard M06's bottom edge centred in the thickness (use the dowel jig): 3/8 in dowel holes 1 1/16 in deep and 1/8 in pilots 1 1/4 in deep.
Glue in the dowels and the panel edge, fit the panel, then drive the screws snug, not tight.
warnings: Keep M06's ends flush with M04's ends: both must fit between the sides.

title: Fit the right side M01 to the top, bottom and both headboards
text: Set the top and bottom assemblies on their front edges on the floor, 64 in apart outside to outside, headboards up, as they sit in the cabinet.
Drill the M01 ends of M03, M04, M05 and M06 centred in the thickness (use the dowel jig): 3/8 in dowel holes 1 1/16 in deep and 1/8 in pilots 1 1/4 in deep.
Glue the eight dowels and the four panel ends, then lower the right side M01 on, plate side down.
Drive all twelve screws snug, then check the cabinet is square by measuring both diagonals.
warnings: You need a helper to lower M01 onto all four panels at once.

title: Fit the left side M02 to the other ends
text: Drill the M02 ends of M03, M04, M05 and M06 centred in the thickness (use the dowel jig): 3/8 in dowel holes 1 1/16 in deep and 1/8 in pilots 1 1/4 in deep.
Glue the eight dowels and the four panel ends, then lower the left side M02 on, plate side down.
Drive all twelve screws snug, then check both diagonals again.
warnings: You need a helper to lower M02 onto all four panels at once.

title: Stand the cabinet against the wall and find the studs
text: Stand the cabinet upright with its wall side against the wall where the bed will go.
Plumb the front edges of both sides with a level, with shims under the bottom where the floor is uneven.
Find the stud centres behind the cabinet with a stud finder and mark each stud line on the wall above the cabinet and down the headboards' front faces.
warnings: Two adults are needed to stand the cabinet up: it is heavy and top-heavy.
The cabinet must be fixed to at least three studs; find them before you go on.

title: Fix the headboards to the studs with six lag bolts KK
text: On each stud line, mark one hole 3 in down from the top edge of the upper headboard M05 and one 3 in up from the bottom edge of the lower headboard M06.
Drill each hole 3/16 in through the headboard and on into the stud.
Drive a 1/4 x 3 in lag bolt KK into each hole until its washer head is snug on the headboard.
warnings: Wooden studs only: do not use drywall anchors, and do not fix into masonry or metal studs.
Fix into at least three studs.
Drive the lag bolts with a socket wrench, not an impact driver, and do not overtighten them.

title: Fit the three wall brackets HH on top of the cabinet
text: Set a wall bracket HH on the top M03 at each stud line, flush on the top and flush to the wall.
Mark A1 to A4 on each stud line, measured from the wall as dimensioned in the drawing, and drill them. A1 takes the bracket's own steel dowel.
Mark A5 and A6 through the bracket onto the wall and drill 3/16 in pilots into the stud.

Fix each bracket with all six fasteners: the 1/4-20 Allen-head screw II up through A2 from inside the cabinet, two #12 x 3/4 in screws JJ in A3 and A4, and two lag bolts KK through A5 and A6 into the stud.
warnings: Wooden studs only: do not use drywall anchors, and do not fix into masonry or metal studs.
Fix into at least three studs.
Drive the lag bolts with a socket wrench, not an impact driver, and do not overtighten them.
Each bracket must sit flush on the top and flush to the wall before any fastener is driven.
hold: Screw-tip clearance: proposed #8 x 1-1/8 in screws for the stop M07; JJ screws checked against the bracket thickness. Owner to confirm.
Rockler's 5/8 in blind holes leave about 0.08 in in 0.703 in stock; the guide proposes 1/2 in. Owner to confirm.

title: Drill the bottom and top joint holes in both sides
text: Lay both sides inside face up: L01 (the side against the bed) and L02 (the outer end).
Mark each row from the front edge and the bottom end, as dimensioned in the drawing.
Drill the two 3/8 in dowel holes 1/2 in deep, then the three 3/16 in screw holes right through.
Turn each side over and countersink the screw holes on the outside face.
warnings: Set the depth stop and test every hole size on scrap first.
Keep shelf-pin rows and slide screws out of the joint bands.

title: Drill the fixed-shelf joint holes in both sides
text: On both sides, mark the fixed-shelf row 14 to 14 3/4 in up from the bottom end.
Drill the dowel and screw holes as for the bottom and top rows.
warnings: Set the depth stop and test every hole size on scrap first.
hold: Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.

title: Fix the bottom L04 to the side against the bed, L01
text: Stand L01 on its back edge, inside face toward you.
Drill L04's end at L01: two 3/8 in dowel holes 1 1/16 in deep and three 1/8 in pilots 1 1/4 in deep, centred in the thickness (use the dowel jig).
Glue in the dowels and the panel edge, fit the panel, then drive the screws snug, not tight.
warnings: Check the bottom is square to the side before the glue sets.

title: Fit the recessed plinth L05 under the bottom
text: Set L05 under L04, 3/4 in back from the front edge.
hold: Plinth L05 attachment to the bottom L04 and the sides not decided.

title: Fix the shelf above the drawer, L07, to L01
text: Drill L07's end at L01 as for the bottom.
L07 is 1/4 in shallower than the sides: keep its front edge flush with the front.
Glue in the dowels and the panel edge, fit the panel, then drive the screws snug, not tight.
hold: Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.

title: Fix the top L03 to L01
text: Drill L03's end at L01 as for the bottom.
Fit L03 flush with the top end of L01.
Glue in the dowels and the panel edge, fit the panel, then drive the screws snug, not tight.

title: Fit the outer end L02 over the bottom, shelf and top
text: Drill the free ends of L04, L07 and L03 as before.
Glue all six dowels and the three panel ends, then lower L02 on together.
Drive all nine screws snug, then check the case is square by measuring both diagonals.
warnings: You need a helper to lower L02 onto all three panels at once.
hold: Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.

title: Fit the back L06
text: Check the case is square, then fit L06 to the wall side.
hold: Back L06 attachment not decided (inset with cleats and screws, rabbet or groove).
Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.

title: Build the drawer box L11 to L15
text: Join the drawer sides L11 and L12 to the back L13 and inner front L14, and support the bottom L15.
hold: Drawer box joints (L11-L14) and the drawer-bottom L15 support not decided.
Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.

title: Fit the slides, the drawer box and the drawer face L16
text: Fit the slides to the sides and the drawer box.
Fix the face L16 from inside the box with four #8 x 1 in washer-head screws.
hold: Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.
Drawer box joints (L11-L14) and the drawer-bottom L15 support not decided.

title: Fit the drawer pull
text: Drill the pull holes through L16 and fix the pull.
hold: Pulls not chosen: model, fixing screws, height and edge offset, hole centres and clearance.
Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.
Drawer box joints (L11-L14) and the drawer-bottom L15 support not decided.

title: Drill the shelf-pin holes and set the shelves L08 to L10
text: Drill the shelf-pin rows in both sides, then set the three adjustable shelves.
warnings: Keep shelf-pin holes out of the joint bands.
hold: Shelf-pin hole layout not decided (rows, spacing, setback; outside the joint bands).
Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.

title: Place the bookcase beside the bed and restrain it to the wall
text: Stand the bookcase with L01 against the bed's left side M02 and fix it to the wall.
warnings: A tall bookcase must be restrained before use.
hold: Wall restraint for the bookcase not chosen (hardware and position).
Drawer-slide model not chosen. It sets the slide screw pattern, the drawer-box clearance and the space under the fixed shelf L07.
